scientific_integrity: Exact deterministic spectral-shape proof for arbitrary finite positive mixtures; numerical checks only support algebra. No external or independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Requires one scalar passive linear oscillator with positive damping and stiffness and strictly positive exponential covariance weights and rates
Covers exact ensemble stationary spectra, not empirical estimated periodograms
Historical priority not exhaustively established; one-rate spectra were established by Masoliver and Porrà (1993)
title: A universal three-peak ceiling for linear oscillators under multiscale colored forcing
